comparator.name: Econometrie en Operationele Research
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official programme is a three-year, 180-EC bachelor with a strong common mathematical, statistical, programming, economics, econometrics and operations-research core. In year 3 students choose one of four majors and also use minor/exchange/stage and elective space. This pathway instantiates the neutral Econometrics major. Current course names come from the official study-programme page; current formal structure and the major/minor rule come from the 2026-2027 OER; the 2026-2027 transition regulations document the current credit structure inherited from the latest curriculum changes. Zero-credit orientation/guidance activity is not included in the 180 EC.

It differs still more clearly from the data-science route through its accounting, banking, public-economics and behavioural-economics content.

comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The normalized target is the generic Econometrics and Operations Research bachelor. The official programme offers four third-year majors. Econometrics most directly continues the common econometric core and is less domain-specific than Data Science for Econometrics, Quantitative Finance or Quantitative Logistics, so it is selected independently of UCR fit.

progressionAssessment.rationale: Programming, economics and corporate-finance foundations begin in Semester 1. Mathematical Methods, Research Methods and introductory data science precede the mathematics, statistics, econometrics and advanced data work. Algorithms & Data Structures precedes Advanced Algorithms; optimisation follows programming and the main mathematical foundations, while reinforcement learning is reserved for the final semester after programming and machine learning. Every formal prerequisite occurs earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest-match core supports one broad quantitative economics/operations-research curriculum. Data Science for Econometrics and Quantitative Finance each support a coherent, mechanically feasible and substantively distinct additional route. Quantitative Logistics was assessed separately but rejected as not feasible because UCR can supply optimisation and algorithms but lacks enough logistics and supply-chain domain content to make a distinct 24-course logistics programme without padding. Three UCR alternatives are therefore included, which is also the maximum.
